scope: Alpha Magnetic Spectrometer (AMS-02) on the ISS: subsystems and observables, charged cosmic-ray fluxes and ratios, leptons, antimatter searches, isotopes, time-dependent analyses, and the public-evidence ledger (60 sources, 183 claims; last full verification 2026-09-20, some rows 2026-10-02). Public-domain reasoning only.
exclusions: AMS Collaboration internal data, notes, calibration constants, production software, conditions databases, pass names, trigger bits, good-run rules and cuts
Measured detector performance numbers not in the evidence ledger with their context
Collaboration review, blinding decisions and peer review
Other experiments' methods presented as AMS practice

capabilities.name: domain-modules
capabilities.scope: Migrated reference modules (species, subsystems, methods, periods, sources) and working rules; text guidance, not executable checks

capabilities.name: evidence-ledger
capabilities.scope: Structural validity of the ams02 ledger, verification-strength ordering, index sync and preservation of the legacy ledger; not the truth of any claim

capabilities.name: analysis-spec-audit
capabilities.scope: Internal completeness and consistency of a JSON or strict-YAML AMS analysis specification; a clean audit is not physical validity

capabilities.name: legacy-spec-conversion
capabilities.scope: Converts a legacy ams-analysis spec (spec_version 1, JSON or strict YAML) into a measurement-spec artifact; refuses on legacy-audit or contract errors; lossless (original carried under ams02:legacy_spec); fills no missing value

capabilities.name: papers-manifest-and-crdb-query
capabilities.scope: Offline subcommands only (manifest check, URL building, CSV summary); networked fetches are opt-in, need user approval and are not exercised by the tests

capabilities.name: flux-ratio-synthetic
capabilities.scope: Path A: synthetic time-dependent flux and correlated ratio with exposure normalization and closure (to be demonstrated in M2)
